Verstappen wins chaotic Singapore F1 sprint race

Max Verstappen won the Singapore Grand Prix sprint race on Saturday, October 10, marking his first victory of any kind in Singapore. The race start was delayed by over 30 minutes due to heavy rain. The event was chaotic, with nine cars retiring, a record for sprint races. Lewis Hamilton finished behind Verstappen.
